scope: RERoT off, single normal generation stream; no single-CPU-thread restriction
question: Does the explicit HC-Q8 derivative with actually executing aggressive LateBind improve original Q2_0 MTP1 throughput on the frozen canonical request?
comparison_kind: Model precision plus implementation route; NOT a bit-exact implementation-only comparison

B.model: HC-only Q8 derivative, all 934 other tensor payloads byte-verified

primary_metric: sum measured generation milliseconds / sum public completion tokens within each process
statistics: paired log(B/A) latency ratio, geometric center and two-sided Student-t 95% CI, df=3
secondary_metric: client wall milliseconds per public token; prompt timing separately
gates: same current executable and actual inference DSO hashes
five real idle Navi21 GPUs and exclusive GPU lock
no profiling or concurrent compilation/hash conversion
retain every raw response and normal owned shutdown
review all unique output texts without claiming general quality equivalence
success_rule: Declare positive benchmark throughput evidence only if the speedup CI lower bound exceeds one and output/exit gates pass. Precision tradeoffs remain explicit.
stop_rule: Protocol/load/exit failure stops the confirmation; no hidden replacement samples or timeout/quality relaxation.
